data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter weather December 2044 guide helps you make the most of winter boating on the Costa del Sol. While summer draws the crowds, December offers mild temperatures, calm seas, and a relaxed atmosphere. Expect average highs of 16°C (61°F), with 6 hours of daily sunshine and only 6-8 rainy days across the month. Sea temperatures sit around 15-16°C, so bring a light jacket or wetsuit if you plan to swim. The light winds (5-10 knots) make for smooth sailing, especially in sheltered spots like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, and December is low season – meaning more availability and flexible pricing. Whether you choose a Marbella yacht charter for a few hours or a full day, this guide covers everything you need to know.

December Weather Overview for Marbella

December in Marbella is mild and pleasant by northern European standards. The average high is 16°C (61°F), with lows around 10°C (50°F) at night. Sea temperature averages 15-16°C. You can expect about 6 hours of sunshine per day, with the sun rising around 8:20 AM and setting at 6:10 PM. Rain falls on roughly 6-8 days, usually as short showers. The wind is light, typically 5-10 knots from the west or northwest, making for calm seas within 5 nautical miles of the coast. The nearby Sierra Blanca mountains may have snow caps, offering a stunning backdrop.

Best Time of Day for Your Charter

Late morning to early afternoon (11 AM to 3 PM) is the warmest window for a December charter. Temperatures peak around 2 PM. A half-day (4 hours) or full-day (8 hours) charter works well, letting you enjoy lunch at a coastal restaurant. Our Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 (Tier A) are popular for shorter trips, starting at €749 for 2 hours. For longer cruises, the Mangusta 80 (Tier B) includes a free jet ski and costs €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours.

Recommended Boats for December Conditions

Enclosed or semi-enclosed boats provide comfort in cooler weather. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers a heated interior and panoramic views. The Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) is a luxury option with full climate control. For a sportier feel, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) has a protected cockpit. Open boats like the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are better on calm, sunny days. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%).

What to Wear and Pack

Layers are essential. Start with a long-sleeved top, add a fleece or light jumper, and top with a windproof jacket. Comfortable trousers or jeans work well. Sunglasses and sunscreen (SPF 30+) are still needed – the UV index can reach 3-4. A hat helps with the breeze. Non-slip shoes are recommended on deck. If you plan to swim, bring a wetsuit or a change of clothes. Our boats have heated cabins, so you can warm up inside.

Destinations and Activities in December

Sheltered coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés are ideal for winter cruising. You can also head west to Estepona (about 10 NM) or east to Sotogrande (about 15 NM) for lunch at a marina restaurant. The sea is calmest in the morning. Water sports like jet skiing are possible – the Mangusta 80 charter includes a free jet ski. Swimming is chilly but doable with a wetsuit. Wildlife spotting (dolphins, seabirds) is common in winter.

Booking Tips for December 2044

December is low season, so you'll find more availability and flexible pricing. Book via WhatsApp for real-time weather updates and last-minute deals. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, while Tier B (Mangusta 80) is €4,719 for 4 hours. Other boats are priced on request. We recommend booking at least a week in advance for preferred dates. Check our Marbella yacht charter page for the full fleet.
